title: Equivalence of two transition readers
statement: For every natural number $n$ and Boolean string $xs$, the transition-record reader that checks four consecutive two-bit fields and then a successor-state field returns the same result as the reader that checks the first field, skips one work-field pair, checks the next field, and then checks the successor-state field.
